extracted.description: Let's enjoy our festival in this pandemic with homemade mom made yumm recipes. #mommasrecipes #veggies #sandwiched
instruction_lines: First start making syrup.add water and sugar and keep stirring for 1 string syrup then add lemon juice
For SHAKKARPARE÷make dough of flour+oil+salt+sugar.make a hard dough and let it rest for 30 minutes
Now start making flat from small portions of dough and cut in square shape.fry as many in one time and just after frying add them in syrup.
Let them soak the syrup and mix well and let cool bit.
You can add dry sugar too little bit
Stay safe stay healthy stay happy
Enjoy yumm SHAKKARPARE after cooling down.
